nA.text: A · Ink — CHOSEN. Unified dark chrome: sidebar and frame share one ink tone, terminal sits in a softly rounded inset card. Warm coral accent ties to Claude. Pill tabs, 30px rows, color project tiles. Warm feel up front, dense status bar (usage, branch, counts).

nB.text: B · Grid — dense, technical. Edge-to-edge panes, hairline dividers, mono uppercase labels, underline tabs, 24px rows. Most information per pixel, coldest feel. Available as a theme preset.

nC.text: C · Glass — closest to stock macOS. Floating translucent sidebar, segmented tabs, system blue. Most native, least distinctive. Available as a theme preset.
